articles.headline: Ravi Kishan pushes Gorakhpur rail link in Lok Sabha
articles.abstract: The Gorakhpur MP raised the long-pending rail link during Question Hour, citing congestion at the existing station and rising passenger load on the east–west corridor. Railway officials said a feasibility study is under way and would be completed within the financial year, after which a detailed project report would be prepared.

articles.headline: MPLADS funds re-routed to cantonment drainage
articles.abstract: Development funds were diverted to clear the waterlogging that has repeatedly submerged cantonment lanes in the monsoon. Residents welcomed the move but sought a firm completion date; the district administration has committed to finishing the drain work before the next rainy season.

articles.headline: High-mast lighting approved for Charagawan block
Sugar mill dispute: MP promises compensation for farmers
articles.abstract: The report claimed the MP had announced a compensation package for farmers affected by a pending sugar-mill dispute. It was later withdrawn by the publisher.
